title: Fix LHOST validation rejecting tunnel hostnames when DNS lookup fails

target.summary: OptAddressOrHostname#valid? delegates IP address validation to OptAddressRoutable#valid?, which rejects zero addresses. Consequently, setting LHOST to wildcard addresses such as 0.0.0.0 or :: fails option validation on reverse handlers.
